title: The evidence points to ironclad proof
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao's questioning made the informant panic, but a greater conspiracy was brewing—the mysterious figure's sleeve held a Jade Slip that was faintly glowing.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was preparing to respond, a mysterious figure quietly appeared at the assembly. The person wore a dark cyan Taoist robe, their face half-hidden beneath a veiled straw hat, revealing only a pale jaw and a withered wrist. With steady steps, they walked directly toward the interrogation platform, each step seeming to tread on the heartstrings of everyone present. The hall fell silent instantly, even the servant disciples who had been clamoring moments ago held their breath. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his fingertips subtly stroking the broken jade fragment hidden in his sleeve—the aura of the Tianji Record stirred faintly, as if warning of something.

dialogue.content: "Everyone, please remain calm." The mysterious figure stopped before the interrogation platform, their voice hoarse yet carrying undeniable authority. "I am a disciple under the Supervisor of the Sect Affairs Office, sent to thoroughly investigate the recent case of Inner Disciple treason. The evidence—has been found."

text.content: He slowly took out a jade box from his sleeve, and upon opening the lid, more than a dozen letters were neatly arranged inside. The paper was yellowed, the ink faded and mottled, and on the seals were Chen Ji's personal seal that he knew all too well—the one he had personally carved three years ago and never shown to anyone. An uproar broke out among the crowd, some gasping, others cursing, and more directing contemptuous gazes at Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: "These are all secret correspondence between Chen Ji and Ye Qing, the Holy Saintess of the Demonic Path Holy Sect!" The Supervisor disciple held the letters high. "The letters detail the vulnerabilities in the Tianqing Sect's mountain protective formation, the location of the sect's secret vault, and there are multiple mentions—the whereabouts of the Tianji Record Fragment! The goods and the person are both captured, ironclad evidence!"

text.content: Chen Ji stood in place, his expression calm to the point of coldness. His gaze lingered on the pile of letters for a moment, and the corner of his mouth even lifted into a faint, barely perceptible arc—that was the smile of a hunter seeing prey step into a trap. In his heart, he rapidly calculated: these letters were masterfully forged, with even the paper's age and ink color's depth aged to perfection. To prepare such comprehensive fake evidence in such a short time, the opponent's background was by no means simple.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice not loud but clearly reaching everyone's ears. "This senior brother handles cases quite efficiently. May I ask—when and where were these 'ironclad proofs' seized from whom? I don't recall writing any of these things."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji appeared composed on the surface, but in reality he was secretly observing every detail of the scene. The reactions of the watching disciples, the elders' expressions, even the mysterious person's position—all were variables in his calculations.

choices.description: Continue to stay silent, letting the opponent fully perform. The more they expose, the bigger the flaws become.
choices.visible_reward: See through the layout of the mastermind behind the scenes

dialogue.content: The Supervisor disciple coldly smiled and handed the letters to the elder beside him for inspection: "Junior Brother Chen certainly puts on a good act. The handwriting on these letters has been professionally authenticated by the Sect Affairs Office—it matches nine-tenths with your usual copied cultivation techniques! What else do you have to say?"

choices.description: Proactively show weakness, admit some 'facts', tempting the other party to reveal more details.
choices.risk_hint: May be convicted on the spot

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sighed softly, his expression lonely and dejected: "Very well, since it has come to this, I have no desire to quibble. It's just... I have one thing I'm unclear about—who told senior brother the contents of these letters?" His eyes flickered with sharp light. "Could the Supervisory Office already possess more information than what's written in the letters?"

choices.description: Expose the flaws of the forged letters on the spot, attacking instead of defending.
choices.visible_reward: Reverse the tide of public opinion
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may have follow-up moves

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly stepped forward, and in everyone's astonished gaze, he picked up a letter from the jade box. He brought it close to his nose and lightly sniffed, frowning: "This ink scent... is it the Pine Smoke Ink from 'Ink Fragrance Studio' in Qingyun Alley? This ink was discontinued three years ago due to a shortage of raw materials. Did senior brother think it was too hasty to use such 'ironclad evidence' to frame me?"

text.content: Just as the two sides were at a stalemate, a cold voice came from the back of the crowd: "Wait." Everyone turned to look and saw Su Qingyao in a white robe, gracefully emerging from the side door of the Council Hall. Her brows and eyes were like frost, her steps composed, each step carrying the unique authority of the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. The Supervisor disciple's expression slightly changed, but quickly regained composure: "Senior Sister Su, this is the Sect Affairs Office handling a case, please do not interfere—"

dialogue.content: "Sect Affairs Office handling a case?" Su Qingyao coldly interrupted him. "Clause seventy-two of the sect rules: Cases involving major crimes by Inner Disciples must be jointly reviewed by the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow and three elders before a verdict can be reached. Which elder authorized you, the Supervisory disciple? Do you have an official document stamped with the Sect Master's seal?"

text.content: The Supervisor disciple's face flushed red, fine sweat appearing on his forehead. He clearly hadn't expected the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow to personally intervene, nor had he anticipated that the other party would be so familiar with the sect rules as to recite them clause by clause. Chen Ji quietly watched, nodding secretly in his heart—Su Qingyao's reaction speed was even faster than he had anticipated. Her choice to intervene at this moment was by no means coincidental.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao walked to the interrogation platform and took out several letters from the jade box. Her slender fingers brushed across the surface of the letter paper, then suddenly stopped: "The first point of suspicion—this letter was written on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month last year, mentioning 'the emergence of the Tianji Record Fragment'. But as far as I know, the Tianji Record Fragment wasn't discovered by Chen Ji in the market until March of this year. May I ask—is this 'foresight' because Chen Ji has the ability of prescience, or is someone deliberately fabricating the timeline?"

She flipped the letter over and pointed to the wax seal on the opening: "The second point of suspicion—I have seen Chen Ji's personal seal. The real seal has fine wear marks on the edges, which only come from long-term use. But the seals on these letters have sharp, clear edges, clearly newly carved." She raised her eyes to directly stare at the Supervisor disciple. "The number of people who could have obtained the original of Chen Ji's personal seal is probably very few, wouldn't you say?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao raised two points of suspicion, causing an uproar throughout the hall. The Supervisor disciple's forehead was beaded with sweat, his gaze unconsciously glancing toward a certain direction in the crowd—where a middle-aged cultivator with a gloomy face was standing, one of Ling Yuan's direct disciples.

choices.description: Follow her words to dig deeper, pointing the finger at the real mastermind behind the scenes.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the tacit understanding with Su Qingyao

dialogue.content: Chen Ji opportunely took over the conversation, his voice not loud but clear and crisp: "Senior Sister Su's keen observation, Chen Ji truly admires. However, there is one more thing—the source of this Pine Smoke Ink is registered in Qingyun Alley. May I ask the Supervisory senior brother—in which shop were these letters purchased? Chen Ji very much wishes to know who is paying for this 'case of treason'."

choices.memory_label: 陈机记住了苏青瑶在危难时刻的挺身而出

choices.description: Not rush to take action, letting Su Qingyao press the attack alone and see how the opponent responds.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to expand the victory

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, giving the stage to Su Qingyao. He noticed Su Qingyao's gaze sweep across the crowd and pause for a moment at a certain spot—where a middle-aged cultivator with a gloomy face stood, exchanging glances with the Supervisor disciple. Chen Ji silently memorized this face, coldly thinking in his heart: So Ling Yuan's people couldn't hold back after all.

dialogue.content: "The third point of suspicion, and the most important one." Su Qingyao took out a thin silk cloth from the last letter, on which was written a passage of bizarre text. "This is secret script from the Demonic Path Holy Sect, completely incomprehensible to ordinary people. But Chen Ji has never left the Tianqing Sect once in the three years since joining the sect. How could he have such deep exchanges with Ye Qing?" She raised the silk cloth. "Unless—someone deliberately delivered these 'materials' to Chen Ji, waiting for him to be 'embroidered in treason'."

text.content: The Supervisor disciple's expression completely changed. He opened his mouth but couldn't make a sound. The surrounding discussions grew louder and louder, and some people began to question whether this so-called "ironclad evidence" had been a trap from the very beginning. Chen Ji gazed down at this scene, but in his heart he was rapidly calculating—Su Qingyao's three points of suspicion were incisive, each knife cutting precisely at the weakness of the forged evidence. But why was she helping him? How much did she actually know?

dialogue.content: Just as everyone thought the outcome was decided, the always silent Ling Yuan finally spoke. His voice was old and majestic, echoing through the Council Hall: "Qingyao girl, your mind is meticulous, I am no match for you." He slowly stood up, his turbid eyeballs looking at Chen Ji. "However—I am quite curious—what exactly is the motive of the person who forged these letters? If it's not Chen Ji who committed treason, then where is the real insider hidden?"

text.content: These words were honeyed poison hidden in cotton, superficially helping Chen Ji out of his predicament, but actually pointing the finger at an even deeper darkness. Chen Ji's heart tightened—Ling Yuan was indeed an old fox who had been immersed in the sect for a hundred years, muddying the waters with a single sentence. If they continued to investigate further, they would eventually touch upon things they shouldn't touch. Su Qingyao seemed to realize this as well, exchanging a meaningful glance with Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's words plunged the entire hall into an eerie silence. The Supervisor disciple took advantage of the chaos to retreat to one side, and the mysterious figure also quietly stepped back. But Chen Ji noticed that in the mysterious figure's sleeve, something seemed to be faintly glowing...

choices.description: Quit while ahead, don't pursue further. First preserve yourself, settle the overall account later.
choices.visible_cost: The mastermind behind the scenes escapes

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his voice calm: "Elder Ling speaks wisely. This case is full of doubts, and Chen Ji believes the Sect Affairs Office will investigate fairly. However, Chen Ji has one request—since the evidence is in question, I ask the elders here to restore my reputation." His posture was lowering to the point of perfection, but no one noticed that the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve was faintly growing warm.

choices.text: Follow the clues to find the truth
choices.description: Publicly question the mysterious figure's identity, exposing Ling Yuan's scheme in the sunlight.
choices.visible_reward: Uncover the tip of the iceberg

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his eyes, staring directly at the mysterious figure who was about to retreat: "This senior brother, please wait." His voice was unhurried. "The Supervisory Office sending someone to investigate a case is perfectly ordinary. But what I am curious about is—you said you came on orders, yet you don't dare reveal your identity. May I ask—what is that glowing Jade Slip in senior brother's sleeve?"

text.content: The mysterious figure's body stiffened, apparently not having expected his small movement to be noticed. He subconsciously gripped his sleeve tighter, but found that the light had already been exposed before everyone's eyes. Ling Yuan's eyes flickered subtly, then quickly returned to normal. The surrounding disciples all turned to look, whispers rising once more. Su Qingyao stepped forward, her gaze like a sword piercing toward the mysterious figure: "Why doesn't senior brother take out what's in your sleeve and let everyone see—what exactly is being hidden more urgently than that pile of forged letters?"

dialogue.content: "Enough." Ling Yuan suddenly waved his sleeve, an invisible pressure enveloping the entire hall. "Today's matter is full of doubts and requires further deliberation. The Supervisory Office will first detain this person for my personal interrogation. As for Chen Ji—" his gaze fell on Chen Ji, his meaning difficult to decipher. "His movement restriction is temporarily lifted, but he is not to leave the sect by even a single step. Until this case is concluded, he remains a suspect."

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head in agreement, his posture respectful beyond reproach. But in his heart, he was coldly laughing: Ling Yuan's move of sacrificing a pawn to protect the king was brilliantly executed, pushing all the blame onto a scapegoat while he himself remained firmly in control. More importantly—the Chen Ji he rescued today would become even more difficult to shake off in the future. This old fox's every move was calculated to the last detail.

dialogue.content: The crowd gradually dispersed. Before leaving, Ling Yuan cast a deep glance at Chen Ji, the meaning in that gaze making Chen Ji's back slightly cold. And as the mysterious figure was led away, the light from the Jade Slip in his sleeve finally dimmed, but Chen Ji had already seen the patterns on it—the same source of aura as the Tianji Record Fragment. This round, he had lost half a move. But the bigger game had just begun.

text.content: Su Qingyao walked to Chen Ji's side, her voice extremely low: "Tonight at the hour of the rat, behind the scripture library at the Rear Mountain, I have something to ask you." She didn't wait for Chen Ji's response before turning and leaving, only leaving behind a faint delicate fragrance. Chen Ji gazed at her departing figure, his eyes deep and dark as ink. Today's situation—if Su Qingyao hadn't intervened—he might have been able to prove his innocence, but he would have been severely weakened. Was she enemy or ally? Or did she have some deeper purpose? The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve lightly trembled, as if responding to his chaotic thoughts.
